title: Root transition preserves the independently glued pro-etale vector trace
statement: Let l be prime, E a finite extension of Q_l, n natural, A the corresponding coefficient quotient at level n+1, S Noetherian with l invertible, and F a rank d vector bundle. For r≤s with both prime powers killing A, take the ordinary bundle coefficient map obtained by pulling back baseExponentComparison, then compare it to the pro-etale site. Its compact-support direct image followed by vectorIntegration at r equals vectorIntegration at s. The compactification and vector traces are the independently fixed constructions of [def-pur-proetale-vector-integration], and the coefficient transition is the ordered root transition of [def-pur-finite-site-coordinates]. Only this one global pro-etale trace equation is asserted, without any tensor coefficient K or transpose.

proof.text: Apply the forward projective square and inverse cancellation, then the open counit square and ordered recursion, on every trivializing open of S. Thus the local ordered integrations agree after the coefficient transition.

The prefixes specifying localIntegration are natural in the ordered coefficient. The two resulting global pro-etale maps have the same local normalizations. The compact-support source and constant target are degree zero, so uniqueness in degree-zero gluing identifies them, equivalently the uniqueness clause in the independently constructed vector integration. This includes rank zero and the empty cover.

theorem vectorExponentIndependence (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian S]
    (hS : IsUnit (l : Γ(S, ⊤))) (r r' : ℕ) (h : r ≤ r')
    (hA : ((l ^ (r + 1) : ℕ) : Scheme.finiteTateCoefficient l E n) = 0)
    (hA' : ((l ^ (r' + 1) : ℕ) : Scheme.finiteTateCoefficient l E n) = 0) (d : ℕ)
    (F : SheafOfModules.{u} S.ringCatSheaf) [F.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank d] :
    (rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (Scheme.finiteTateCoefficient l E n))
      (Etale.vectorBundlePurityCompactification S d F)).map
      ((comparison (Scheme.finiteTateCoefficient l E n) _).map
        ((Etale.ordinaryFinitePullback _ (VectorBundleZeroSection.π S d F)).map
          (baseExponentComparison l E n S hS r r' h hA hA' d).hom)) ≫
      vectorIntegration l E n S r hA d F hS =
        vectorIntegration l E n S r' hA' d F hS
